name: RingCentral MCP
description: Connects ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients to RingCentral call logs, AI call notes, SMS, voicemail, fax and team chat, for RingEX business phone users.

skills.name: Call Activity
skills.description: Gets your recent and missed calls, returned calls, connected-call time and outstanding callbacks for a set time window.

skills.name: Call Notes and Transcripts
skills.description: Gets AI notes and transcript text for one call and searches your calls by person, topic and date window.

skills.name: SMS, Voicemail and Fax Inbox
skills.description: Gets your SMS, voicemail and fax records for a date window, newest first, and reads one message including voicemail transcription.

skills.name: Send SMS
skills.description: Sends one SMS from a phone number you own, after the client shows the sender, recipient and exact text and you approve it.

skills.name: Team Chat
skills.description: Reads Team Chat chats, posts, notes, tasks and events, and sends posts with optional file attachments to a chat or a person.
